criteria: Select at most one candidate for a separate confirmation. Both must preserve the 95% throughput floor and 110% p99/allocation ceilings against the release. Prefer the wake candidate for contention if it improves median throughput by at least 2% or median p99 by at least 5%, with that metric improving in at least four of six rounds. Otherwise select the token candidate for allocation if median bytes per notification falls by at least 12 bytes with lower allocation in at least four of six rounds. If neither qualifies, record both results and stop this screen. Do not combine the two changes.

Confirm on the four canonical workloads using three alternating release/candidate pairs per workload in fresh JVMs. Keep the focused sample separate from confirmation. Retain a change only if it passes all functional checks, meets the three parent-relative budgets on every workload, and its targeted benefit repeats in the contended confirmation (throughput or p99 in the direction used to select wake, or at least 12 fewer B/notification for token). Publish the individual trial rows and relevant uncertainty. No dropping rows or repeating an unchanged failing treatment to erase the result.
